newsitem.title: USA: U.S., Japan business leaders seek open tech market.
newsitem.headline: U.S., Japan business leaders seek open tech market.

text.p: U.S. and Japanese business leaders called on Wednesday for "free, fair, and global" markets for information technology products.

In a joint statement issued at the end of a two day meeting in San Francisco, the business leaders said; "free, fair, and global must characterize world markets in information technology products and services."
They said the private sector should work to "further the rapid development and liberalization of trade in telecom products and services in the two countries."
The joint statement was issued by more than 70 business leaders who attended the meeting, sponsored by the U.S.-Japan and Japan-U.S. business councils.
